meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Codex 作为命令行智能体，与 Claude 并用或替代，支持工具调用与历史续接。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你 用的工具支持多智能体（如 OneCLI），想换成或搭配 OpenAI 的代码模型。
copy.tagline_en: Configure Codex as your coding agent, with tool use and session history.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use OneCLI and want to replace or pair Claude with OpenAI Codex.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按步骤把 Codex 装成 NanoClaw 的智能体后端:复制代码、注册组件、重建容器、引导登录;之后群组可切到 Codex 负责规划与工具调用。
howto.when: 当你要求把 NanoClaw 的智能体后端换成 Codex,或想安装/启用 Codex 提供方(ChatGPT 订阅、OpenAI API 密钥)时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Codex 装成 NanoClaw 的智能体后端。
say.note: 会执行安装、注册并引导认证。

say.text: 把群组 demo 的智能体后端切换到 Codex。
say.note: 用 ncl groups 更新配置并重启该群组。

say.text: 让以后新建的群组默认用 Codex。
say.note: 会先询问是否修改实例默认提供方。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can walk through adding Codex as a NanoClaw agent backend: copy code, register components, rebuild the container, and guide login. Groups can then be switched to Codex for planning and tool orchestration.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to install or enable Codex as a NanoClaw agent backend, or to set it as the default provider for new groups.

say_en.text: Install Codex as the agent backend for this NanoClaw.
Switch group demo to the Codex backend.
say_en.note: Updates the group config and restarts it.

say_en.text: Make new groups default to Codex from now on.
say_en.note: Asks before changing the instance default.
